cohort: Deliveries affected by meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
finding: Several perinatal factors including primigravida status, maternal diabetes, chorioamnionitis, prolonged rupture of membranes, assisted vaginal delivery, cesarean section, breech presentation, thick meconium, fetal distress, and nonvigorous newborn status were significantly associated with non-performance of delayed cord clamping in deliveries with meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
